paper.title: Preparation and Adsorption of CO2 and H2 by Activated Carbon Hollow Fibers from Rubber Wood (Hevea brasiliensis)

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet): ~60 cells, 0 numeric disputes; the single-sample scope (only WC-ACHF-1.0% is text-anchored; the other four samples are figure-only), the 77 K temperature (298 K in the conclusion is a typo), the CO2 exclusion, uptake_type=unspecified and empty dopant_element (incidental N/P) all confirmed. Agent C adjudication: (1) the 100-bar row (4.51 wt%) downgraded to Tier C and confidence 4 -- Fig 4b shows the excess maximum near ~25-30 bar and the ~100-bar point slightly lower, so '4.51 at 100 bar' pairs the run-window pressure with the curve maximum (the paper states this pairing in text, recorded with the caveat); (2) functional_groups unit corrected to at.% (Fig 2a XPS [at.%]: C 91.26, N 1.06, O 7.34, P 0.35).

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper labels these 'hydrogen storage'/'H2 adsorption storage'; the only 'excess' strings are 'excessive' about charcoal powder
notes.onlyone: only WC-ACHF-1.0% has text-anchored values; the other four samples (0, 0.5, 2.0, 3.0%) have only figure-only per-sample uptakes (Fig 4 insets) and figure-only textural parameters (Fig 3 inset), which are unanchorable (section 3.4 step 6) and are not recorded
notes.assign: the 77 K/1 bar value 2.24 wt% is the maximum of the stated 2.06-2.24 wt% range and WC-ACHF-1.0% is stated to be the highest sample at both 1 and 100 bar, so 2.24 is assigned to it (slight inference; extraction_confidence 4; WA-2.0 is only ~0.01 wt% lower)
notes.pmax: Fig 4b shows the WC-ACHF-1.0% 77 K excess isotherm peaking near ~25-30 bar with the ~100-bar point slightly lower; the abstract/body state '4.51 wt% at 77 K and 100 bar', so 4.51 is the curve maximum reported against the 0-100 bar run window, not necessarily the 100-bar value; recorded at 100 bar per the text with Tier C and confidence 4
notes.typo: the conclusion prints '4.51 wt% at 298 K and 100 bar'; the abstract, Fig 4b and the methods all give 77 K, and H2 was measured 0-100 bar at 77 K, so 298 K is a typo and temperature_k=77 is recorded
notes.co2: CO2 adsorption (273 K; 4.76-7.13 mmol/g) is a different gas and is not extracted
notes.porevol: total_pore_volume_cm3_g 0.860 is the text value for WC-ACHF-1.0%; per-sample micropore (t-plot) and mesopore (BJH) volumes are figure-only (Fig 3 inset); pore_volume_method=unspecified (single total value)
notes.psd: the porosity is bimodal ultramicropores at ~0.50 and ~0.56 nm, not a single average, so no average pore diameter is recorded
notes.hetero: N (1.06 at.% by XPS for WC-ACHF-1.0%), O and P are incidental, from the wood-liquefaction precursor (H3PO4 activation, hexamethylenetetramine), not deliberate heteroatom doping, so dopant_element is left empty (incidental-heteroatom convention); 'doping' in the title refers to the 1 wt% wood-charcoal carbon additive
notes.charcoal: WC-ACHF-1.0% is an activated carbon hollow fiber from rubber-wood liquefaction doped with 1.0 wt% wood charcoal powder (based on wood liquefaction) in the spinning solution, steam-activated at 800 C
notes.bet: surface_area_method=BET: the 1902 m2/g value is text-anchored ('specific surface area ... 1902 m2 g-1') and labelled BET in the Fig 3 inset and Fig 4d axis
notes.method: H2 adsorption/desorption 0-100 bar and 0-1 bar at 77 K on an Automated Sievert's apparatus (Advanced Material Corp.); fully reversible; N2 flow 100 mL/min during activation; sample mass and blank/calibration not stated

S1.label: WC-ACHF-1.0%
S1.material_description: wood-charcoal-doped activated carbon hollow fiber (WC-ACHF-1.0%) from rubber-wood (Hevea brasiliensis) liquefaction, melt-spun, steam-activated at 800 C; 1.0 wt% wood charcoal powder additive (based on wood liquefaction)
S1.activation_method: steam activation at 800 C, 1 h, 10 g/min steam, N2 flow 100 mL/min; precursor from H3PO4 wood liquefaction, melt spinning, half-curing
S1.functional_groups: incidental N (1.06 at.% by XPS), O (7.34 at.%) and P (0.35 at.%) from the wood-liquefaction precursor (C 91.26 at.%, Fig 2a); not deliberate doping

measurements.source_location: body 'Hydrogen Adsorption Performance' (1-bar range 2.06-2.24 wt%, WC-ACHF-1.0% highest; Fig 4a inset); BET 1902 m2/g and total pore vol 0.860 cm3/g body; method 'Methods'
measurements.note_extra: 1-bar cryogenic row: chahine scored a by-hand 1 (section 5); Tier B either way

measurements.source_location: abstract and body (highest H2 uptake 4.51 wt% at 77 K, 100 bar for WC-ACHF-1.0%; Fig 4b inset); method 'Methods' (Automated Sievert's, 0-100 bar, 77 K)
